items.title: Root Authority remains the governing layer
items.decision: APPROVED: Heart Core and Root Authority govern all downstream runtime, knowledge, registry, capability, and execution layers.
items.measurement: Root authority report remains ACTIVE with score 100 and no drift.

items.title: Knowledge evidence is required before decisions
items.decision: APPROVED: Every governed decision must link to knowledge, lessons, runtime evidence, or PR governance output.
items.measurement: Every decision item has sourceKnowledge and measurement fields.

items.title: Runtime API contract stability is mandatory
items.decision: APPROVED: Extension-facing runtime APIs must follow API Contract V2 or pass through a governed compatibility adapter.
items.measurement: API Contract V2 check report remains ACTIVE with score 100.

items.title: Stability baseline gates expansion
items.decision: APPROVED: No new upper layer is complete until tests, lint, stability score, and drift checks are clean.
items.measurement: Stability report remains STABLE with score 100 and drift detector returns NO_DRIFT.

items.title: Curated merge is required
items.decision: APPROVED: Raw merge is disallowed; PRs require checks, governance review, drift control, and curated human decision.
items.measurement: PR governance has review decision output and GitHub checks are green before merge.

items.title: Capability Registry V2 is the next allowed layer
items.decision: APPROVED: Capability Registry V2 may activate only after Decision Registry V2 is ACTIVE with score 100.
items.measurement: Decision Registry V2 report status is ACTIVE, score is 100, and missing checks are empty.

items.title: Execution Fabric V2 remains gated
items.decision: APPROVED: Execution Fabric V2 must wait until Decision Registry V2 and Capability Registry V2 are both active and governed.
items.measurement: Execution Fabric V2 remains listed as blocked until capability registry readiness is proven.
